slides.title: They already know your name
slides.body: It's on your resume. Opening with it wastes your best 10 seconds.

slides.title: Use Present - Past - Future
slides.body: *Present:* what you do now. *Past:* one result you're proud of. *Future:* why this role.

slides.title: Example (fresher)
slides.body: "I'm a final-year B.Com student who runs our college fest budget. Last year I cut costs by 18%. I want to grow that into a finance analyst role here."

slides.title: Keep it under 60 seconds
slides.body: Practise out loud 5 times. Record yourself - your fillers (um, actually, basically) will surprise you.
